description: Places parking motos is a dataset listed in Saemes OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saemes. Ce jeu de données fait état du nombre de places motos dans les parkings Saemes. Coverage: Paris region (Saemes car parks). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Parking public, Parking résidentiel, Se garer, Paris, Ile-de-France, Parking motos. The portal shows 63 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-11-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-saemes-fr-portal.
